rows.coder_note: Step 4 (rules D, I1): the consortium name with exact case and control counts (133,384; 113,789) and no year, citation, accession or platform; exact counts with a consortium name alone do not identify a release; the outcome side has BCAC rows, so C2 does not apply.

rows.quote: Outcome data for overall breast cancer and subtypes were sourced from the Breast Cancer Association Consortium (133,384 cases, 113,789 controls) and FinnGen DF 11 (20,586 cases, 201,494 controls).
rows.coder_note: Step 2 (rule A): 'FinnGen DF 11' is data freeze 11 modifying the dataset name, the release R11 in another written form; the case and control counts are endpoint-specific and not a conflict (rule H).
